name: Triple macro+sentiment+vol: macro risk-off cross + extreme fear + crypto vol spike (no funding axis)
rationale: Thesis: a funding-free triple to prove the confluence edge is not secretly a funding-carry trade. The three axes are: macro_regime crossing DOWN into risk-off (drifting — cross_down only), crypto crowd at extreme fear (fear_greed low), and a crypto realized-vol spike (vol_realized high) marking the forced-selling climax. The macro cross supplies timing; sentiment + vol supply the capitulation confirmation. Long-only spot, medium hold. Disconfirmer: must beat (a) macro_regime cross_down ALONE on deflated Sharpe after fees — if the regime cross matches, the fear+vol gates are decorative; and (b) the funding-based capitulation triple (spec core) — if that beats this, the real edge IS funding carry and the macro/vol framing is a worse proxy. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: macro_regime crossing risk-off during extreme fear and a vol climax
